author: imaginariumarts
title: Seeking Ongoing Artist for YouTube Channel Assets
content: ARTISTS AND DESIGNERS LISTEN UP!!! A pal of mine recently started his YouTube channel journey, and is seeking an ongoing artist to commission for assets! ... seeking ongoing artist for main channel assets and “branded” designs... The bulk of the work would be for channel art with fast turnaround time for his video content, and wants HUMAN MADE not AI! Preference given to those who can replicate Kirby style content and character drawing... You will be paid fair compensation, so be ready to send your rates for consideration along with your samples if requested! Potential for additional work... COMMENT BELOW AND LET’S SEE WHERE IT LEADS YALL!

author: HappeningInMCR
title: Seeking Digital Artists for Collaborative Commission
content: Collaboration Commission with @cultureword We’re looking for 6 North-West based digital storytelling partnerships (each comprised of 1 writer and 1 digital artist) to explore these questions in a co-created original piece of creative work. Forms you could work in include, but are not limited to: gaming, animation, film, narrative-based websites or social media pages, apps, audio fiction, transmedia storytelling. Successful partnerships will be awarded £800 (£400 per creative) to develop their idea. Final pieces will be displayed during Cultureword’s Creative Lock-In (27th November 2026) Deadline 7th October Link: https://cultureword.org.uk/job-opportunities/merge-collaborative-commission-2026/ #happeninginmcr
